# Hypatia

> Hypatia turns a git repo's Markdown into a team wiki: one page per part of the code, a map of how the parts connect, and a live view of who is working on what, kept current by your coding agent. Node 18+, no dependencies. Install with `npx hypatia init`.

## Install

- [Agent install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxhawksby/hypatia/main/INSTALL-AGENT.md): a numbered checklist for coding agents installing Hypatia in a repo and writing its first wiki pages.

## Docs

- [Wiki](https://maxhawksby.github.io/hypatia/): how it works, the team view, the privacy guard, the agent skill, configuration.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxhawksby/hypatia/main/README.md)
- [Working on Hypatia itself](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxhawksby/hypatia/main/AGENTS.md)
